sentences.en: It doesn't matter what I say, she always contradicts me.
sentences.zh: 无论我说什么，她总是跟我唱反调。

sentences.en: Let our action never contradict what we have said.
sentences.zh: 我们的行动绝不能与所说的话相矛盾。

sentences.en: No one dares to contradict his employer for fear of being fired.
sentences.zh: 没有人敢反驳他的雇主以免被解雇。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：contra（相反）+dict（说）→说反对的话→反驳
